comment: The same script runs against the GUI mock (web/src/features/core/connections.parity.test.ts) and the real backend (modules/core/handlers_connections_test.go). Where the backend deliberately differs it says so in `real`. $KEY_PLAIN, $KEY_LOCKED are replaced by keys/ed25519 and keys/ed25519-passphrase next to this file. {name} in a path is the id kept by an earlier step.
